title: Block Decomposition of a Supercuspidal Datum
body_html:
Block Decomposition of a Supercuspidal Datum

Let \(\Sigma=(x,\Gamma,\phi,\rho)\) be a supercuspidal datum. Group the field factors of \(F^0[\Gamma]\) by the positive numbers \[ r_b>\ldots>r_1>0 \] obtained from the negative valuations of the components of \(\Gamma\), and put the nonnegative-depth and zero components into a separate block. This yields orthogonal decompositions \[ V=\bigoplus_{l=0}^{b}V_l,\qquad \Gamma=\bigoplus_{l=0}^{b}\Gamma_l, \] with compatible decompositions of the centralizer, building point, character, and finite reductive quotient representation.

The resulting data \[ \Sigma_l=(x_l,\Gamma_l,\phi_l,\rho_l) \] are single blocks, with positive depths \(r_l\) for \(l>0\) and a zero-depth block for \(l=0\). The notation \[ \Sigma=\bigoplus_{l=0}^{b}\Sigma_l \] is the block decomposition of \(\Sigma\). It is unique up to the equivalence of data used in the paper.
